assumptions.statement: The Overall Design Area and three key-area polygons use repository provisional rough geometry because verified official polygons are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Geometry-derived area and ratio metrics are low-confidence design-model values, not official redline or precise-area claims.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace all dependent geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, and PDFs when organizer-supplied official polygons become available.

assumptions.statement: Approved Regulatory Detailed Planning controls, road boundaries, setbacks, ownership, utilities, fire access, flood, and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, Building Height, development rights, capacity, and feasibility remain unknown; no statutory conclusion is made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Update geometry, metrics, DRR decisions, sections, and project packages after official controls are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Building condition, structural safety, heritage status, tenancy, and relocation data are insufficient for a confirmed DRR schedule.
assumptions.impact: Footprints and morphology prototypes illustrate a method; they do not authorize demolition or construction.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Complete measured survey, ownership, structural, heritage, social-impact, and cost review.

assumptions.statement: Walking, cycling, transit, robot testing, and delivery routes are conceptual because detailed counts, station-interface drawings, and permissions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Routes demonstrate hierarchy and conflict management, not approved operations or engineering alignments.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Validate through transport surveys, accessibility audit, operator coordination, and authority review.

assumptions.statement: Personas and AI-enabled scenarios are design-validation constructs, not tracked profiles, completed consultation, or operating services.
assumptions.impact: Scenario metrics are future evaluation proposals; AI cannot replace medical, legal, safety, planning, or professional judgment.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Calibrate through lawful engagement, accessibility testing, pilots, and professional review.

assumptions.statement: Detailed heritage inventories, protection boundaries, archaeology, and approval requirements are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Cultural narratives and landmarks remain conceptual; no intervention in protected fabric is authorized.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Coordinate with verified heritage records and competent conservation authorities.

assumptions.statement: Projects, phases, operators, and indicators lack confirmed budget, land commitment, procurement, or government implementation decision.
assumptions.impact: Phasing distinguishes reversible pilots from capital works but does not promise delivery.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Prepare feasibility, financing, ownership, governance, and approval studies.

assumptions.statement: Generated scenes and composed diagrams are explanatory presentation artifacts.
assumptions.impact: They are not photographs, verified behavior, official renderings, public consent, or approval evidence.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Update figures whenever authoritative geometry or the adopted spatial design changes.
